description:
REFUTED AS WRITTEN (reader, develop f822f0f84, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/t93_2/report.md). The wait graph never contains a cycle: 0 nontrivial SCCs in 11,555 checks on the distiller and on even/odd, even/odd-list and a 3-cycle. Partner is directional: producer reaches reader through standing waits; the reader's side of the cycle is a Current read registered at its completion (347/347 distiller partner events had no reader->producer wait path). So a group over waits answers 0/347 partners; a group over waits + unconcluded Current reads misses 193/347 first detections and over-approximates (~1% of non-partner calls); a persistent partner group changes 1,131 answers (1,102 Concluded->Partner, 29 Wait->Partner) and 98/172 pairs expire, so union-find cannot hold it. waits_reach (56,562 calls: 55,583 early exits, 979 DFS, 347 true) cannot reach 0 with identical decisions; a per-epoch memo leaves >=682 DFS. revive_blocked_chain asks a different question (first never-run producer downstream along waits; 498 calls, 332 demand) and stays.

Two relations were conflated: (1) partner = transient reachability in the live wait DAG, asked before the reader's closing edge exists; (2) cycle group = SCC over waits + partner reads, which exists only after partner reads register — that is fz-afu.15's 'group concludes together', a semantic change, not a refactor.

Original description:
The engine maintains cycle groups as waits are added (merge when the new wait's target already reaches the waiter), and answers group(job). World::answer_use's partner test and revive_blocked_chain read it. Deletes World::waits_reach (drive.rs ~932; 56,562 calls / 979 walks on the distiller, one pair found 48 times) and the DFS in revive_blocked_chain (drive.rs ~819). Paper first: a partner's answer is READ Current, not waited on, so partner edges may leave the wait graph once a partner is detected — establish on even/odd and a 3-member group which edges the group must be built over (waits only, or waits plus Current reads of unconcluded facts) before building. Predict and measure: identical outputs/dumps; waits_reach count -> 0. Blocked by the crate move.
title: The engine knows which cycle group a waiting derivation is in
